farmerId.title: Farmer ID
farmerId.description: Registry-wide unique holder identifier, e.g. FRM-000123.

issuerId.title: Issuer
issuerId.description: Which Issuer this holder belongs to. Every issuer's holders share this one entity ON PURPOSE: the wallet self-service chain is keyed end to end on `farmerId` (Keycloak user attribute -> access token claim -> registry lookup in oid4vc-service), and splitting holders across per-issuer entities would break a flow that is verified working from a real wallet. The entity name is therefore historical; the portal calls these records whatever the owning issuer's `holderLabel` says. A record with no issuerId is shown as unassigned rather than hidden.

keycloakSub.title: Keycloak subject
keycloakSub.description: Immutable Keycloak user id (`sub`) of the citizen this record belongs to. Written by the issuer portal when the record is linked to a login; the wallet's self-service issuance resolves the caller's token to a record through the mirrored `farmerId` user attribute, and this field is the reverse index.

keycloakUsername.title: Keycloak username
keycloakUsername.description: Human-readable login, for portal display only. Never used for identity matching — usernames and emails change.
